**Do not attach a save file, and do not paste raw save header bytes.** A save
header carries your platform name, account id and player display name in
plaintext. Output Clockspeed prints under default flags is redacted and safe
to paste.

For wrong or skipped game content, use the content form in
`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/content-gap.yml` instead. For a security problem, do
not open a public issue - follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Game build

version number.
